title: Odd parity: exact n-1 full-B2 gate bound, independent baseline

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. Let L(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee.leading. Let R(n) be the sum of the monomials in guarantee.remainder.terms, each coefficient times n^exponent*(log2 n)^log_exponent*(log2 log2 n)^loglog_exponent; an empty sum is zero. There exists N such that C_B2(f_n)>=L(n)-R(n) for every integer n>=N. All remainder coefficients are the exact declared constants. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"L is the language of all finite bit strings of odd Hamming weight. For every n>=0 and every x in {0,1}^n, f_n(x)=x_1 XOR ... XOR x_n, with f_0=0. The uniform deterministic evaluator scans the actual n bits; its NP verifier accepts only the empty witness and iff the scan parity is 1.","guarantee":{"kind":"eventual_lower_bound","leading":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"remainder":{"kind":"explicit","terms":[{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}}]}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For every integer n>=1, the minimum number C_B2(f_n) of retained gates in an exact deterministic acyclic one-output circuit with two input pins per gate, all 16 binary Boolean tables and unrestricted sharing is exactly n-1. Consequently C_B2(f_n)>=n-1 at every n>=1, and liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/n=1.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v2"}
